Name: Simple Villager Schedule
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[center][size=6][b][color=#D8B4FE]✦ Simple Villager Schedule ✦[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center][b][color=#67E8F9]Find your favourite villagers. See their day at a glance.[/color][/b][/center]
[center]Choose a villager from a compact grid of full character sprites, then see their current location, next planned stop and today's schedule. Keep track of conversations, weekly gifts, birthdays and quest contacts in one place.[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#FDE68A]👥 Choose Your Villager[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center]• Browse full standing sprites with clear names and a quick search.
• Keep your favourites at the front of the list.
• Find active quest contacts immediately after your favourites.
• Scroll with the mouse wheel, native draggable scrollbar or arrow buttons.
• Use an adaptive layout with keyboard and controller support.[/center]
[center][b][color=#D8B4FE]Favourites[/color][/b] → [b][color=#FDE68A]Quest contacts[/color][/b] → [b][color=#67E8F9]Everyone else[/color][/b]
Each group is alphabetical. A favourite who also has a quest appears once and keeps both markers.[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#67E8F9]🗺 Where Are They Now?[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center]Open a villager to see their [b]actual current location[/b], [b]next planned stop[/b] and [b]today's full loaded schedule[/b]. Readable place names include places such as Outside Library, Pelican Town Park and In front of their house, where the location can be identified.[/center]
[center]A cropped nearby map shows their current area with their [b][color=#86EFAC]full character sprite[/color][/b] marking their position. Friendship hearts, birthday information and known friendship-door restrictions appear alongside their details.[/center]
[center][b]Schedule times show when villagers leave for each destination.[/b] Events and other interruptions can change their movements, so actual location is shown separately from the plan. Unrecognised areas use their normal location name.[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#86EFAC]✓ Everyday Indicators[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center][b][color=#D8B4FE]★ Favourite star[/color][/b] — quickly recognise your saved favourites.
[b][color=#FDE68A]! Quest marker[/color][/b] — Stardew's native exclamation mark identifies supported active quest contacts.
[b][color=#86EFAC]☑ Talked today[/color][/b] — a checked or unchecked box shows your conversation status.
[b][color=#67E8F9]0/2 · 1/2 · 2/2[/color][/b] — see your actual weekly gift count.
[b][color=#D8B4FE]🎂 Birthday cake[/color][/b] — spot villagers celebrating today.[/center]
[center]Gift counts are read from your farmer's records. Extra recorded gifts remain visible, and spouses or roommates show their count without a two-gift weekly limit.[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#D8B4FE]⚙ Make the Grid Your Own[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center]Use the [b]cogwheel at the top right[/b] to toggle the talked-today checkbox, weekly gift counter and quest marker. All three start enabled, and your choices are saved.[/center]
[center]Hiding quest markers keeps quest contacts in their usual position after favourites. Favourites are stored separately for each save and farmer.[/center]
[center]Optional [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] also provides these switches, the mod and shortcut toggles, and a configurable keyboard or controller opening button.[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#FDE68A]🎮 How to Use[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center]Open the normal game menu's [b]backpack tab[/b] and select the [b][color=#67E8F9]clipboard shortcut[/color][/b]. Choose a villager to open their details.[/center]
[center]• [b]Mouse:[/b] click to open a villager; right-click a card to add or remove a favourite.
• [b]Details:[/b] use Add favourite or Remove favourite.
• [b]Controller:[/b] move through the grid, A to select, B to go back, Y to favourite and X to search from the picker.
• [b]Scrolling:[/b] use the wheel, scrollbar, arrows or controller triggers.
• [b]Optional hotkey:[/b] choose an opening button in GMCM. It starts [b]unassigned[/b].[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#67E8F9]🤝 Modded Villagers & Multiplayer[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center]The browser reads loaded character artwork and today's schedules, including eligible expansion villagers from mods such as [b]Stardew Valley Expanded[/b] and [b]Ridgeside Village[/b]. Seasonal and replacement sprites remain visible.[/center]
[center]Villagers must be social, visible to your farmer, unlocked and have a usable schedule for today. Hidden helpers, animals, temporary event actors and characters without schedules are excluded.[/center]
[center]Quest markers use recognised NPC contacts and active delivery objectives, including participating special orders. Custom scripted quests may not expose a supported contact. Completed, cancelled, hidden and expired quests are excluded.[/center]
[center]For farmhand schedule browsing, install the mod on both the [b]host and viewing farmhand[/b]. The host supplies today's plans; each viewer uses their own friendship, visibility and favourite records. If host plans are unavailable, the browser reports this.[/center]
[center]Browsing reads your existing game state. It leaves villager routines, friendship rewards and quest progress intact. Nearby maps preview loaded map tiles and the selected villager rather than every dynamic object in the scene.[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#D8B4FE]🌍 Languages[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center]Follows your game's selected language, with support for all [b]12 built-in languages[/b]:
English • French • German • Spanish • Brazilian Portuguese • Italian
Russian • Japanese • Simplified Chinese • Korean • Turkish • Hungarian[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#86EFAC]📦 Requirements & Installation[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center][b]Required:[/b] Stardew Valley [b]1.6.15+[/b] and SMAPI [b]4.4.0+[/b].
[b]Optional:[/b] Generic Mod Config Menu for convenient settings and keybinding.[/center]
[center]1. Install SMAPI.
2. Download and extract Simple Villager Schedule.
3. Place the [b]SimpleVillagerSchedule[/b] folder inside your Stardew Valley [b]Mods[/b] folder.
4. Launch the game through SMAPI and open the clipboard shortcut from the backpack tab.[/center]
[center][color=#C084FC]✦ ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ✦[/color][/center]
